meta.title: AI Gijinka · Shared World, Individual Personas
meta.description:
Personas follow the selected DSH model, with shared world lore and preferences plus separate personalities, memories and model-specific guidance. Edit files, create characters or change bindings through conversation. Versions in one model family share a character and memories by default; presets and bindings are customizable.

Optional experimental AI diaries and idle-time consolidation are enabled separately and use model tokens to record and revisit each character’s experiences.

The companion is an independent optional display: in-page or a Windows x64 native window, with foreground task animations, statistics and balance/plan data available from the connected provider. Personas work without the companion.

ui.diary.title: AI Diary
ui.diary.warning: Enabling this uses additional tokens. Usage is uncontrolled and cannot be estimated.
ui.diary.description: Each character has a separate space in the selected folder and decides when, what, and how to write.

ui.sleep.title: Sleep Consolidation
ui.sleep.description: When all conversation tasks are idle, the currently selected model organizes the current character's diaries from yesterday and earlier. Background consolidation stops when a new task starts.
ui.sleep.warning: Automatically calls AI in the background and uses additional tokens. Usage cannot be estimated.
